description: The outcome of a community governance proposal, written into the community repo at resolution time. It cites the exact evidence the outcome was computed from — the proposal state, the voter-signed vote records that were counted, and the quorum rule applied — so a third party can recheck the decision without trusting the community's PDS.

community.description: DID of the community whose repo holds this decision.

proposal.description: Strong reference (uri + cid) to the proposal record as it stood when the decision was computed, before the resolution rewrite.

proposalRkey.description: Record key of the proposal record in the community repo.

quorum.description: The quorum rule that was applied to reach this outcome.

tally.description: Counts derived exclusively from the cited vote records.

votes.description: Every voter-signed vote record counted toward this outcome.

uncountedVotes.description: Votes present in the proposal's non-authoritative vote cache that produced no countable vote record, and were therefore excluded from the tally. Present so the gap is enumerable rather than silent.

evidenceComplete.description: True when every vote in the proposal's cache was backed by a countable vote record — i.e. uncountedVotes is empty.

supersedes.description: Strong reference to an earlier decision record for the same proposal that this one replaces. Written when a resolution is retried after a crash and the tally has since moved to a different outcome, so the contradiction is explicit rather than silent.

action.description: The change the proposal asked for. Whether it was successfully applied is recorded in the audit log, not here.

threshold.description: Minimum number of counted votes required to resolve.

rule.description: Human-readable statement of the rule applied.

voter.description: DID of the voter, i.e. the owner of the repo holding the vote record.

record.description: Strong reference to the voter-signed net.openfederation.governance.vote record.

proposalCid.description: The proposal CID the vote record attests to; always a member of the proposal's CID lineage.

castBy.description: Delegate who cast this vote, when the vote record carries delegation provenance.

reason.description: Why the vote produced no countable record (e.g. no-vote-record, unknown-proposal-cid, stale-vote-record).
